question: Could you calculate the average of the total runs scored by all strikers who have scored more than 50 runs in any single match?
sql:
-- Calculate the average of total runs scored by all strikers who scored >50 runs in any single match
WITH striker_match_totals AS (
    SELECT b.striker, b.match_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as match_total
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id
),
qualifying_strikers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT striker
    FROM striker_match_totals
    WHERE match_total > 50
),
striker_grand_totals AS (
    SELECT qs.striker, SUM(smt.match_total) as grand_total
    FROM qualifying_strikers qs
    JOIN striker_match_totals smt ON qs.striker = smt.striker
    GROUP BY qs.striker
)
SELECT AVG(grand_total) as average_total_runs
FROM striker_grand_totals
